title: Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A twist on traditional Indian BBQ, these Uruguayan beef skewers are marinated in a mix of spices and grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lime juice, olive oil, ginger paste, garlic paste, garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, and salt.
Add the Uruguayan beef strips to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated beef strips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the Uruguayan beef skewers hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
